warm.native_before_cancel_editor_text:
## A clear three-stage browser workflow

This stable sample page lets anyone try Matrx Extend without signing in. The page contains a real article, useful links, a structured table, and JSON-LD metadata so the extension's page-aware features have predictable material to work with.

## The three workflow stages

| Stage | Purpose | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Capture | Turn the open page into readable content. | Article text, links, media, metadata, and schema. |
| Understand | Ask questions about what is actually on the page. | Answers grounded in the current page. |
| Use | Extract the details needed for the next task. | Structured rows that can be copied or reused. |

## Why page-aware assistance matters

A browser assistant is most useful when its answer is grounded in the page the user chose. Matrx Extend can capture readable content on demand, inspect page structure, and use that context to answer a direct question. Automatic capture is optional and is off on a fresh installation.

The user remains in control: read-only tools can inspect the active page, while the default interaction mode asks before an action changes a page. Privileged actions always require confirmation.

GUEST99-CANCEL-PEER-20261021
